brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: North-half bases at levels 0, 1 and 2, snapped together.
One drawer on the cut face of the level-0 base.
A full-depth, 2-compartment bin in the level-2 base, with no cover.

finish.summary: A single-cell tower of three half bases. It has a drawer on level 0 and an open 2-compartment bin on level 2. Open faces are capped and the joints are locked. check_build reports meshClash clear and no issues. I added no props.

lines.label: Bin, north half, full depth, 2 compartments
Cut-face cap, east-west · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
